30050101.text: Come and have a good look yourself! Traditional spices of the highest quality, made with pride and experience!

30050102.text: Haha, you've got a deal! I can't thank you enough for always looking after my business.

30050103.text: Believe me, I'm not making this up. Several Eremite mercenary groups are nearly in open conflict, but does the Corps of Thirty care? *sigh* And that's not all, did you know that...

30050104.text: Wow, talk about hurly-burly, this place is busy! Guess that's only to be expected for the largest port in Sumeru. Uh, maybe it's because of what Dehya told us earlier, but Paimon can't seem to shake the feeling that there's also danger lurking in these crowds.

30050105.text: Let's get our bearings so we can start looking for leads.

30050106.text: We know that whatever the Akademiya lost is related to the gods... But other than that, we don't have much else to go on.

30050107.text: Hmm... Asfand told us to try posing as Akademiya students while asking around. Paimon checked the Akasha on the way here, and the Akademiya doesn't seem to have any research facilities in Port Ormos.

30050108.text: Paimon doesn't get it... Won't we look even more suspicious going around saying we're Akademiya students AND asking about the stolen item?

30050111.text: Well, given all the people that come through here every day, if there's any information to be found, Paimon bets we could find it in the market. Let's ask around and see what we come up with.

subQuests.subQuestName: Ask a nearby merchant for information

30050201.text: Welcome, welcome! How can I help you two?

30050202.text: Hi there, we would like to ask you a question. Uh, do students from the Akademiya ever come to Port Ormos?

30050203.text: Hehe, of course, especially around this time of year. Students from Sumeru City that are about to graduate often come to Port Ormos to cut loose a little.

30050204.text: Many people often talk about how hard it is to get accepted into the Akademiya, let alone graduate. But those who finish their studies and go on to become full-time researchers at the Akademiya have it even harder.

30050205.text: Sure, we may not be Sumeru City, but Port Ormos offers beautiful scenery and a stress-free environment. Some even say it's good luck to come to Port Ormos, so students and researchers come flocking here when things get to be too much at the Akademiya.

30050206.text: Ah, you see over there? Those are students from the Akademiya.

30050209.text: They've been looking worried and miserable ever since they got here a few days ago.

30050210.text: If you ask me, the life of a merchant is better. So long as the Akasha teaches us what we need, then life is good.

30050211.text: Hmm, those students seem to be discussing something... Let's see if we can listen in.

subQuests.subQuestName: Eavesdrop on the Akademiya students' conversation

30050301.text: *sigh* It's no good... I've tried asking around, but I haven't been able to learn anything useful. Not to mention that a bunch of scary-looking Eremite mercenaries have been posted along the streets now.

30050302.text: There's been a lot of fighting between the different Eremite factions in Port Ormos. If we choose to move on our own, then it would be wise to steer clear of them.

30050303.text: Especially the group that's constantly shouting some stuff about "King Deshret" and some "resurrection." I've even heard that the Citadel of Regzar is starting to get fed up with them. What was that group called again...? Ayn something or other...

30050304.text: They're called Ayn Al-Ahmar. Today I heard that the thing we're after might be in their possession at the moment.

30050306.text: Don't you see? Many of the Eremites in Port Ormos deal with trading this kind of thing.

30050307.text: They're usually pretty wary of outsiders, but not so with students of the Akademiya. It's because the kind of goods that students are looking for aren't the kind of goods the Eremites are after. As long as they know you're a student, then deals can be made.

30050308.text: I've heard that Ayn Al-Ahmar likes to set up shop at the Djafar Tavern. Supposedly, if you're willing to part with half a million Mora, they'll give you info on anything.

30050309.text: Wa—Wait, did you just say half a million!? If information alone costs that much, then how could we ever afford to buy what we're looking for? *sigh* I guess we might as well give up on trying to graduate this way.

30050310.text: I wouldn't worry too much. Our field of research is very niche. Who else could possibly be after that kind of shady knowledge? I bet it's practically worthless to anyone aside from us.

30050311.text: Oh, I guess that makes sense. Then the only thing left for us now is to find a way in. Why don't we all just pool our money together and pay for the information?

30050312.text: Whoa, did you hear that? A niche field of research and shady knowledge... It all sounds pretty suspicious to Paimon. Is knowledge something people just buy and sell like that?

30050401.text: You sit down and wait for some time...

30050402.text: Oh, you've arrived. Please take a seat.

30050403.text: So they think that they can go toe to toe with the boss? Hah, once we reclaim the power of King Deshret, they'll be the first that the boss punishes.

30050404.text: They're nothing to be afraid of. Our main rival now is The Caracal Battalion. They've also amassed a significant amount of Mora this time, so we mustn't underestimate them.

30050405.text: How can The Caracal Battalion compete with the boss when they're nothing but a bunch of money-grubbing opportunists out for a quick Mora?

30050406.text: Yeah! With Boss's fervent devotion, he'll be able to use this power to bring our god back this time.

30050407.text: Huh, all these guys talk about is King Deshret, so they're probably the ones we're looking for.

30050408.text: Hmph, Greater Lord Rukkhadevata... That traitor and her followers must not be spared! The day will come when King Deshret exacts vengeance on Sumeru, and all of them shall be punished.

30050411.text: Yeah, Paimon was wondering what they meant, too. We should ask about that if we get the chance later.

subQuests.subQuestName: Find a place to sit and wait for the Eremites to arrive
Get some information from the Eremites

30050501.text: Huh, who are you? What do you want?

30050504.text: Uh, now's probably not the time to talk about that. Didn't the students say Eremites are wary of outsiders?

30050505.text: I'm a student from the Akademiya.

30050506.text: A student? Heh, what's a student from Sumeru City doing in Port Ormos?

30050507.text: I'm looking for info about a certain... "something."

30050508.text: Ahh, well if it's info you want, you've come to the right place. The question is: Can you afford it?

30050603.text: Thank you for your help back there.

30050604.text: No need for thanks. My goal was to get to them, and you two gave me just the opportunity I needed. We're even.

30050605.text: Oh, I advise you to keep your distance from them. Since they weren't able to make off with your Mora in the end, they might harass you again in the future.

30050607.text: Hold your horses! We still have something to ask you about.

30050608.text: Since you tore through their scam right in front of them, you must know the real story about a... certain something, no?

30050609.text: Who exactly are you two, and why are you inquiring about that?

30050610.text: I'm a student from the Akademiya.

30050611.text: A student? Heh, right. Look, you should know that those thugs conducting "business" with you had nothing to do with your lie.

30050614.text: #Huh? Oh, yeah! {M#He}{F#She}'s really strong! Weren't you saying something about a "physical exchange"? We can help with that.

30050615.text: #{M#He}{F#She} doesn't even have a Vision. Forget it.

30050616.text: #Maybe not, but {M#he}{F#she} can still use elemental energy! Otherwise, there's no way we'd go asking for info from Ayn Al... Al... hmm, from guys like that!

30050617.text: Those hot-headed thugs are definitely gonna bring a lot of back-up for your next meeting. Even if you don't go alone, you won't regret taking us with you!

30050620.text: Alright, I accept. Got a pen and paper? If you're searching for someone who sells that kind of merchandise, I'll give you one of their addresses, and you can try your luck.

30050621.text: We'll reconvene at the appointed time by the pier. It doesn't matter if you show up or not.

30050622.text: Um... So, since you were happy to give us this merchant's information, does that mean you can tell us exactly what we're after?

30050623.text: You were willing to part with 500,000 Mora for something, and you didn't even know what it was?

30050624.text: Okay, well if you truly are as skilled as you claim, then you can beat the answer out of them when they become hostile.

30050625.text: Look, if you've been making inquiries, then you have to know something by now. Tell me what you know so far, so I don't waste time repeating information.

30050626.text: We know it's connected to the Akademiya somehow, and that not only do the Eremites deal in it, but some students wanna get hold of it, too. Umm, what else...

30050627.text: It seems like some kind of knowledge.

30050628.text: You know almost everything there is to know, but you're unable to compile this information because you've never seen the object before.

30050629.text: This is what you've been looking for.

30050630.text: Huh? Paimon can't tell what it is... It looks like some kind of ornament?

30050631.text: This is a Knowledge Capsule. To put it simply, it's a vessel that can store a fixed quantity of Canned Knowledge. It's like a miniature Akasha.

30050632.text: Anyone who links it to their personal Akasha Terminal instantly becomes privy to its contents.

30050634.text: Correct, anyone. Unlike the Akasha, which heavily regulates who can access what information, Knowledge Capsules confer their contents without any requisites.

30050636.text: It's essentially a convenient and harmless vestibule for knowledge. Unfortunately, it's illegal in Sumeru to privately possess or trade them.

30050637.text: They were created as a means for scholars to transfer knowledge gained from Irminsul into the Akasha, and are intended to be destroyed immediately after use.

30050638.text: But despite strict regulations, some of these Knowledge Capsules will always escape destruction. After all, there will always be those in this world who are dissatisfied with life as designed for them by the Akasha, and wish to change their fate.

30050639.text: Over the past century, a wide variety of Canned Knowledge has been leaked from the Akademiya. Now, in Port Ormos, the valuable ones are a means to Mora for the Eremites.

30050640.text: Meanwhile, those which the Eremites deem to be useless to them occasionally prove useful to the common citizens and hapless Akademiya students.

30050641.text: Well, I think that about sums it up.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go with Alhaitham to a more secluded spot to continue your conversation

30050701.text: Let's continue our conversation here. If you wish to learn more about the Knowledge Capsule that the Akademiya lost, then you must help me with something.

30050703.text: I need you to find someone named Dori, a traveling merchant.

30050704.text: Unlike the peddlers who hawk inferior Knowledge Capsules, she often has quality goods in stock. Some say that as long as there is profit to be made, there is nothing she won't dare to sell.

30050705.text: She is guarded against people from the Akademiya because most of her wares don't comply with Akademiya regulations.

30050706.text: I think she blacklisted me. I met with her informant, but it soon became clear that they had no intention of letting me get any further.

30050707.text: Become one of Dori's customers and earn her trust. This is my condition for further collaboration.

30050708.text: Why do you want us to meet with her?

30050709.text: Until you complete this task, you don't have question privileges.

30050710.text: Uh... Fine. So how do we go about doing this?

30050711.text: You two are outlanders who haven't been here for long, so Dori should view you as "safe" clients. I'll give you the informant's address and their contact password.

30050712.text: Beyond the password, though, I have no way of knowing what other tricks she might have up her sleeve. You'll have to improvise.

30050714.text: The true challenge begins after you meet her. She has a keen nose for Mora and a shrewd eye for wares, and she only likes customers who she deems to have good taste.

30050715.text: I'll prepare some funds for you. Buy her highest quality wares and earn her approval.

30050716.text: But we only just saw a Knowledge Capsule for the first time! We don't know how to tell which ones are good and which ones are bad. Uh... Is that something we can learn quickly?

30050717.text: Hm, that's true... Have you two heard of Elemental Sight?

30050719.text: Oh? That's a surprise. Guess I'll have to hold you in higher regard. Anyway, that ability should resolve your issue.

30050720.text: Here are two Knowledge Capsules. Tell me, can you detect any difference in their quality?

30050721.text: Umm... They look the same to Paimon.

30050722.text: Try inspecting them with Elemental Sight.

30050723.text: How'd it go? Did ya see anything?

30050726.text: Rumor has it that higher-quality Knowledge Capsules generally appear brighter when viewed through Elemental Sight.

30050727.text: That's because knowledge originates from Irminsul, the root of Dendro power itself. The more powerful the knowledge, the richer it is in Dendro energy.

30050728.text: However, some Canned Knowledge with a high concentration of Elemental Energy is of little use in contemporary times, so those capsules are of little value.

30050729.text: Using Elemental Sight is merely a stop-gap measure, but it should suffice for earning Dori's trust.

30050731.text: Here's a sheet with the informant's location and contact password, and here is the Mora for purchasing Canned Knowledge.

30050732.text: Don't be cheap. You'll need to spend to catch Dori's eye. If there's any Mora left over, just keep it.

30050733.text: Oh, and be sure to exercise some caution. There have been matra present in Port Ormos lately. Your efforts will be for naught if they catch you.

30050735.text: They belong to the Akademiya's regulatory body. They also handle cases of illegal Canned Knowledge transactions. Like I said, the Akademiya has banned both their trade and possession.

30050736.text: The matra are razor-sharp — you're in for nothing good if they lock their sights onto you. If you two want to back out, now's the time.

30050801.text: Hello, what are you two looking to buy?

30050803.text: Wait, are you sure you're remembering that right? Paimon doesn't think it was that on the paper.

30050804.text: We want to buy some unripe Harra Fruits.

30050805.text: Heh, what a unique palate. We have unripe Harra Fruits, but we usually keep them in the back. I'll have someone escort you.

30050806.text: Following the paper got us past the first round!

30050807.text: Raunak, these two want to buy unripe Harra Fruits. Show them to the warehouse.

30050808.text: Got it. You two, please follow me.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the warehouse with Raunak

30051001.text: I'm sorry, but as things currently stand, we won't be able to fulfill your order. Why don't you two think things over?

30051002.text: He's cautious of us. Let's take a closer look at the paper that Alhaitham gave us.

30051101.text: Okay, everything has been confirmed. Miss Dori is waiting for you up a— Shoot, it's the matra! Run!

30051102.text: What, the matra!? Where? Alhaitham said we're done for if they catch us — we gotta get outta here!

subQuests.subQuestName: Find the owner of the voice

30051201.text: Here, over here! You can stop running now.

30051202.text: So you were the one who was calling out to us just now. But uh, are we definitely gonna be safe here?

30051203.text: These two good customers wish to buy some Harra Fruit, Miss Dori, and if there's nothing else, I'll just excuse myself.

30051205.text: Huh, wait... You're Dori? Paimon sure thought you'd look a whole lot scarier...

30051206.text: Hey, whaddya trying to say, Princess Peabrain!? I can be scary enough when I need to be, believe you me! If you don't watch what you say, then you can forget about doing any business.

30051207.text: But it seems you two have actually done pretty well so far... Not only did you manage to find the informant, your reactions were also pretty sharp. You don't really look like criminals or anything, but I bet my Mora that you've been involved in some shady dealings, haven't you?

30051208.text: Uh, Paimon's not sure if that's supposed to be a compliment, but we'll take it.

30051209.text: I can't risk doing business with people who start huffing and puffing after just a few paces — no matter how much Mora they might have. Not only will they get caught by the matra, but they'll also get us into trouble. As decent folks trying to run an honest business, we don't need any of that. Wouldn't you agree?

30051210.text: So that's why I prefer to have customers like you.

30051211.text: It's your first time here, but don't worry, I won't ask too many questions. Even if you wish to buy enough Knowledge Capsules to decorate your house with, please — knock yourself out!

30051212.text: As long as you have lots of round, shiny Mora, then we're all good.

30051213.text: Can you show us your products?

30051214.text: Ah yes, of course, of course! Go ahead, help yourselves — voila!

30051215.text: (Wow, she has a trove of Canned Knowledge! Whew... she'd probably be in serious trouble if the matra caught her with all this.)

30051216.text: What kind of products do you seek, my dear customers? Don't worry, I'm not interested in your reasons for buying — I can, however, offer some suggestions.

30051217.text: Take this one, for example... "An Analysis of the Sociological Ideology and Dialectics of the Hilichurls." Only three people in all of Teyvat have ever studied it, making it extremely rare! It's on sale now for 350,000 Mora!

30051218.text: (Yeesh... Who would wanna be an expert in that topic?)

30051219.text: Or how about "The Architectural Styles and Construction Methods of Teyvat in the Early Archon War Period"?

30051220.text: With this one, you can become an expert in historic architecture preservation and find an excellent, well-paying job in nearly any nation!

30051221.text: (Now this sounds like it could be useful...)

30051222.text: Two million Mora and it's yours. No discounts.

30051223.text: Whoa! That's a lot of Mora!

30051224.text: Of course, you are free to pick whatever your hearts desire. The contents and price of each Knowledge Capsule are indicated in small text on the body of each one, down at the bottom.

30051225.text: (All right, let's try the method that Alhaitham mentioned.)

30051229.text: Ahhh... You've really got a good head on your shoulders... and quite the eye for quality.

30051230.text: You pick and choose a variety of Canned Knowledge...

30051231.text: We'll take these, please and thank you!

30051232.text: My, oh my, you are blessed with a taste for both the exquisite and the extravagant... Customers like you are a rare breed — one in a hundred... No, one in a thousand, even!

30051233.text: Listen, I have a special offer for you two. If you spend just 100,000 Mora more, you can pick any Knowledge Capsule of your choice up to a value of one million Mora!

30051235.text: Hey, did you hear that!? Spend another 100k and we get a capsule worth a whole million!

30051238.text: But all the Canned Knowledge we just bought is easily worth half a million Mora. If we spend just a little more, we can get something worth one million Mora. Isn't that a fantastic deal?

30051239.text: Think about it, we've gone to all this trouble to get this Canned Knowledge, and so far everything we've bought belongs to Alhaitham.

30051240.text: Aren't you even the least bit curious about how this whole Canned Knowledge thing works? We're talking instant knowledge here! Don't you wanna try it yourself?

30050901.text: Before I retrieve your products, I need to confirm a few things.

30050902.text: Please forgive me, but we may not have sufficient stock for you today. Earlier, many of our Harra Fruits were taken by mice.

30050904.text: Hold on, that's not right. "Taken by mice" means they sold out.

30050906.text: Heh, thanks. If better goods come in, you'll be the first to know.

30050907.text: You look like you have some skill. Why don't I pick out some fruits that'll make you dizzy?

30055101.text: Please, just leave. Forget the cost of the meal... Just uh, pretend nothing happened today.

30055201.text: Half a million... That's a lot of Mora.

30055202.text: Do you really think that Ayn Al-Ahmar group can give us reliable info about what we're after?

30055203.text: We should discuss things thoroughly before we make any moves.

30055301.text: It's been a while since I've visited the Citadel of Regzar. I'll catch up with Chief for a bit before I head back myself. He really did a lot for me in the past.

30055302.text: Remember, to get to Port Ormos, just follow the river south from Sumeru City's port.

30055303.text: Just be sure to take care of yourselves out there. We'll meet again at the Sabzeruz Festival.

30055401.text: Hah, you two must really be something if you've got Dehya the Flame-Mane speaking on your behalf.

30055402.text: The Corps of Thirty isn't officially overseen by the Akademiya, but because we're hired mercs, there's still lots of sensitive intel that I can't reveal to ya. In the end, when it comes down to it, the city's safety is both the Corps' and Akademiya's top priority.

30055403.text: I've told you all I can about what was stolen from the Akademiya... As for why you should pretend to be students in Port Ormos, I'll leave that for you to find out yourself.

30055501.text: (Latish smiled and winked at you to keep up with Raunak.)

30059901.text: This is the place we heard those students talking about.

30059902.text: Let's find a seat somewhere and see if we can spot the group they mentioned.

30059903.text: He went that way. After him!

30059904.text: Looking at what Alhaitham wrote, Dori's informant is a trader near Old Ormos.

30059905.text: Let's follow these instructions and try to get in contact with him.

30059906.text: You two have a fascinating fashion sense. We haven't seen a customer wearing a Sumeru Rose for quite some time.

30059907.text: Hold on, lemme think... "Sumeru Rose" means... common merch.

30059908.text: No, look again. We're obviously wearing Mourning Flowers.

30059909.text: Ah, my mistake. I do apologize.

30059910.text: Phew... That pop quiz sure was scary!

30059911.text: The warehouse is up ahead. Please follow me.

30059912.text: We don't know this area, so let's follow that informant!

30059913.text: Hey! If you're hiding from the Rishboland Tiger, come this way!

30059914.text: Another password! Oh, that voice came from behind the building on the right!
